title: SpoolStatusResponse
description: GET /spool write-spool state, including pending file and offline-symlink work. HTTP 503 with enabled=false when the spool is not enabled. entries is capped at 200 active rows plus a short done tail. Served by the GUI and jm5 CLI.

recovery_enabled.description: Effective local replacement dispatcher configuration when known; does not assert provider capability.

error.description: Present when disabled or on SQL error.

failed_files.description: Distinct from top-level 'failed' (a counter); this is the current count of files in the failed drain_state.

replacement_conflicts.description: Accepted atomic saves held locally after another writer intervened; not failed uploads.

replacement_waiting.description: Accepted atomic saves awaiting writer authority re-evaluation.

offline.description: Spool is holding because the volume is offline.

path.description: Absolute nfs_path of the spooled file.

drain_state.description: Active rows are newest-first; a short recently-done tail may appear.

replacement_state.description: Local accepted-save availability or validated writer disposition; does not authorize retry, discard, or overwrite.
